info.title: Blueprint Canton Chain API
info.summary: Full-history Canton Network chain data over one REST API.
info.description:
Query every Canton Coin transaction since genesis (June 2024), any party's complete history, live balances and holdings, mining rounds, ANS names, network configuration, and aggregated chain statistics.

The API is backed by Blueprint's own Canton validator infrastructure: a continuously ingesting index of the global transaction feed (~seconds behind head), normalized per party, plus live pass-through to the Super Validator Scan API for point-in-time state. All endpoints are read-only GETs returning JSON.

**Cursors** — list endpoints paginate by the monotonic `seq` cursor: pass `before_seq` (newest-first) or `after_seq` (oldest-first, party history only) and chain the `next_before_seq` / `next_after_seq` value from each response. `before_seq=0` means "start at the newest".

**Authentication & rate limits** — browsing is open (anonymous, 300 req/min per IP). Authenticate with an API key — `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>` — to unlock a plan: Free (300 req/min), Pro (3,000), Enterprise (30,000). Live tiers at `GET /api/plans`. Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit` / `RateLimit-Remaining` / `RateLimit-Reset` headers; exceeding the limit returns `429` with `Retry-After`, an invalid key returns `401`.

**Access** — public for evaluation. For a key, production terms, SLAs, or dedicated capacity, contact Blueprint at https://theblueprint.xyz.

**Quotas** — the Free plan includes 10,000 requests/day and 150,000/month (pooled across your keys). Responses on quota-capped plans carry `X-Quota-Daily-Limit` / `X-Quota-Daily-Remaining` / `X-Quota-Monthly-Limit` / `X-Quota-Monthly-Remaining`; an exhausted quota returns `429` naming the window that reset it. Pro and Enterprise have no volume caps — upgrade at https://ccscan.xyz/pricing.

get.description: Head sequence, latest round, indexed totals, 24-hour transaction count, ingest freshness, and the 12 most recent transactions.

latest_tx_date.description: Timestamp of the newest indexed transaction (UTC)

total_tx_est.description: Planner estimate of total indexed transactions

party_count_est.description: Planner estimate of distinct parties ever seen

tx_24h.description: Transactions indexed in the trailing 24 hours

ingest_cursor_at.description: Last ingest checkpoint time — freshness signal

get.description: Newest-first, cursor-paginated global feed. Combine `type`, `round`, and `day` filters freely. `day` navigation costs ~30 index probes via binary search over the sequence key — no scan.

parameters.name: before_seq
parameters.description: Return rows with seq < this value; 0 or omitted = start at newest. Chain `next_before_seq` to page.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Jump to a UTC calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Set to 1/true to attach the full per-transaction `detail` object (transfer legs, fees — sender_fee / receiver_fee / holding_fees / sender_change_fee — and balance_changes) to every row, matching /api/tx/{key}. Off by default to keep the list lean.

next_before_seq.description: Pass back as before_seq for the next (older) page; 0 when empty

get.summary: One transaction by seq or event id

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Sequence number (digits) or full event id (e.g. `#1220…:0`)

200.description: The transaction with its full financial body

get.summary: Substring search over every party ever seen

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive fragment of a party id

get.description: A curated starting set for party discovery: Blueprint's validator, then every super validator, then featured-app providers — each with a display name and tag. All from cached network data.
First/last activity and transaction count (exact up to 100,000, then reported as capped), plus the party's ANS entry when registered.

tx_count_capped.description: true when the party has more than 100,000 transactions

ans.description: ANS entry (name, user, url, description, expires_at, contract_id) when registered

get.description: Balance computed against the most recent valid ACS snapshot from the Scan API: unlocked/locked/total holdings, accrued holding fees, and available coin.

record_time.description: Snapshot time the balance is computed as of

summary.description: Null when the party holds no CC at the snapshot

get.description: The party's active Amulet holding contracts at the latest ACS snapshot (Scan API pass-through, page size 200).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Scan API pagination token from a previous page

schema.description: Live ACS snapshot passed through from the Super Validator Scan API — the party's active Amulet holding contracts.

created_events.description: Array of created-event objects for the party's active Amulet holding contracts; each has contract_id, template_id, created_at, signatories, observers, and create_arguments (create_arguments.amount.initialAmount / ratePerRound.rate, plus lock state on locked holdings).

next_page_token.description: Scan pagination token; pass as ?after= for the next page

get.description: Every transaction the party appears in, from genesis. Page forward (oldest-first) with `after_seq` or backward (newest-first) with `before_seq` — mutually exclusive. Each row carries the party's roles in that transaction.

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description: Oldest-first: rows with seq > this value

parameters.name: before_seq
parameters.description: Newest-first: rows with seq < this value; 0 = start at newest

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Set to 1/true to attach the full per-transaction `detail` object (transfer legs, fees — sender_fee / receiver_fee / holding_fees — balance_changes) to every row — the full per-transaction economic detail. Off by default to keep the list lean.

200.description: One page of the party's transactions

get.description: Transaction count, sequence range, time span, and a newest-first page of the round's transactions.

note.description: present for round 0 (large automation bucket): explains the omitted exact count

get.description: Canton Name Service entries (Scan API pass-through). Filter with a lowercase name prefix.

user.description: The party id the name resolves to

get.summary: DSO, super validators, CC configuration, versions
get.description: Aggregated network metadata: DSO state, the super validator scan directory, Splice instance names, Scan version, and the current Amulet (CC) rules payload.

amulet_rules.description: Current AmuletRules contract payload (fees, limits, schedule)

get.description: Compact one-call snapshot of network economics: on-chain oracle CC price, the current open mining round and its open/close timing, issuance per year, app/validator reward split, synchronizer traffic price, holding-fee rate, SV and featured-app counts, and protocol version. Built from shared upstream caches (30–600s).

oracle_price.description: On-chain amulet price (USD) from the SV oracle

issuance_per_year.description: On-chain annual Canton Coin issuance (amuletToIssuePerYear from the DSO AmuletRules config).

circulating_supply.description: Circulating CC supply: cumulative net minting from genesis (rewards + mints + taps - fees burned), summed from the full index.

marker_value.description: USD value of one featured-app activity marker (featuredAppActivityMarkerAmount).

developer_fund.description: Developer-fund pool: on-chain CC in the DSO's optDevelopmentFundManager party + % of issuance routed.

get.description: Open and recently-closed DSO vote requests, decoded from on-chain contracts into human-readable proposals: action, category, requester, per-proposal tallies. Closed history extends past the upstream ~100-item window via a permanent local archive.

get.summary: One proposal with the full per-SV vote breakdown
get.description: A single vote request by its tracking contract id, including every SV’s vote (`all_votes`), the raw action payload, and the current electorate size (`sv_count`) for the tally denominator.
Voting participation for every super validator across all archived decided proposals: votes cast, accept/reject split, participation rate. Cached ~5 minutes.

participation.description: fraction of decided proposals this SV voted on

get.description: Every party that collected validator rewards in the trailing 7 days, ranked by rewards, with a per-day series. Super validators are flagged with `is_sv`. Background-computed and cached; `pending:true` until the first rollup lands.

pending.description: true until the first background rollup lands

get.description: Daily transaction counts and CC volume by type, aggregated from the full index by a background job. `complete=false` means the genesis backfill is still filling in (progress = aggregated_to_seq / head_seq); days appear oldest-first as it advances.

sv_rewards.description: CC minted as super-validator rewards that day

app_rewards.description: CC minted as app rewards that day

validator_rewards.description: CC minted as validator rewards (coupon de-duplicated: max(reward, faucet))

cc_fees_burned.description: CC burned in sender/receiver/holding fees that day

reward_collections.description: Count of reward-collection transfers that day

econ_complete.description: True once the economics columns cover the full index

get.summary: Per-day tx counts for the last N days (always current)
get.description: Computed live by binary-searching the sequence key at each UTC day boundary — independent of the background aggregator, cached 10 minutes. The last entry is the current partial day.

partial.description: Present and true on the current (incomplete) day

get.description: USD and BTC price, market cap, and 24h change (CoinGecko, cached 120s). `available=false` when market data cannot be fetched.

as_of.description: Unix timestamp the quote was fetched (present when available)

get.description: Classifies the query and returns typed results: sequence numbers and rounds (digits), event ids, exact party ids (`name::fingerprint`), party-id fragments, and ANS name prefixes.

key.description: Seq (tx), round number, or party id — feed to the matching endpoint

ans.description: Present when matched via an ANS name

get.description: The anonymous baseline plus the sellable plans (Free / Pro / Enterprise) with their per-minute limits and included query volume. Free includes 10,000 requests/day and 150,000/month; Pro and Enterprise are uncapped on volume.

note.description: Human-readable note about where the rate-limit budget is reported

get.description: Whether a party is a validator, super-validator, and/or app-provider — derived from the reward types it collects — plus a liveness assessment and recent reward performance. Computed from a bounded scan of the party's most recent transactions, so reward figures are over that recent window (see recent.note), NOT lifetime. Liveness is measured by round progress (Canton issues no validator liveness rewards): active when the party's latest round is within a few rounds of the network head, inactive when further behind, or unknown when the network tip is unavailable; rounds_behind reports the gap.

rounds_behind.description: network_round - our_round; 0 means fully caught up

network_round.description: latest mining round on the network, from the super-validator scan

our_round.description: latest round our validator's participant has recorded

recent.description: Reward performance over the scanned window (recent, not lifetime)

lifetime.description: Exact lifetime reward totals from a cached full-history scan (null if the party is not a validator).

complete.description: false only when the history was too large to total within the timeout; the recent window still applies

pending.description: true while exact totals are still being computed in the background — refetch shortly

get.description: Network head round (from the super-validator scan) vs our validator's recorded height (max round). Powers Active/Inactive.

Featured apps (on-chain FeaturedAppRight, from the SV scan) with per-app app-reward / transaction metrics over 24h and 7d and a 14-day daily reward series. Metrics are aggregated in a background thread and cached.

windows.description: per-window metrics (24h, 7d): txs, app rewards, burns

metrics_ready.description: false until the first background aggregation pass finishes

series.description: 14-day daily app-reward series for the stacked chart

get.description: Weekly reward totals (sv+app+max(validator,faucet)) over the validator's full history, gap-filled. Powers the reward-history chart. Cached 30 min.
Live operational state: chain-index freshness (seconds behind head), upstream Scan API reachability, live-feed buffer, and background aggregate progress. Metering-exempt — safe to poll.

The trailing ~3 minutes of ~2s head-seq samples plus instant/1m/5m throughput — the data behind the landing-page pulse chart. Served entirely from memory and **exempt from rate metering**, so polling every 2s is always safe. Prefer `/api/live/stream` for push.

available.description: false only in the first seconds after a deploy while the buffer warms

t0.description: Unix seconds of the first sample; each ts[i] is an offset from t0

get.description: Server-Sent Events: the `/api/live` payload — plus each newly indexed transaction in `txs[]` — pushed the moment it lands (sub-second after the chain head moves). The first event arrives immediately with a ~30-tx backfill. Streams close after ~120s and `EventSource` reconnects transparently; at capacity the endpoint returns `503` and clients should fall back to polling `/api/live`. Metering-exempt.

200.description: text/event-stream — one `data:` JSON event per chain-head advance

get.description: Per-round transaction counts, time spans, and sequence ranges, newest-first, in one grouped index-backed scan. Page back with `before`. Cached 60s.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return rounds strictly below this round number; 0/omitted = newest

next_before.description: Pass back as before for the next (older) page; 0 when exhausted

get.description: For each party this one transacts with, the directional CC volume — sent, received, and NET — plus counts and first/last interaction, over a window (24h/7d/30d/all). Net exposure is the custody/compliance view a flat interaction count can't give. Big parties compute in the background; the response carries `pending:true` until ready.

get.summary: Registered CIP-56 assets with issued supply
get.description: Canton Coin plus registered CIP-56 (Canton Token Standard) assets — cETH, CBTC, USDCx, etc. — with on-chain **issued supply** from each registry's token-metadata API. Issued supply only: Canton's privacy model keeps per-party balances and non-CC transfer volume off the DSO-scoped Scan feed, so those are intentionally not shown (never fabricated). Cached 5 min.

200.description: Canton Coin + CIP-56 assets with issued supply

capabilities.description: Human CIP-56 capabilities the asset supports: Transfers, DvP / Allocation, Holdings, Metadata.

supported_apis.description: Raw token-standard API ids the asset supports.

note.description: Why per-asset transfer volume / holders are not shown (Canton privacy).

get.description: The featured-app roster and each app's CIP-0116 required lock (5M CC per PartyId, or 25M for an asset issuer) are exact on-chain / spec data. The locked amount is held in a wallet disclosed off-chain to the Foundation, so it populates live from the app→wallet mapping where configured and reads 'pending' otherwise — never estimated.

200.description: Featured apps with required + locked amounts and status

locked.description: Verified on-chain locked CC (sum of the app's segregated lock party LockedAmulet), or null if none.

verified.description: true when `locked` is a verified on-chain figure.

locked_total.description: Sum of verified on-chain locked CC across featured apps.

pre_featured_locks.description: CIP-0116-scale on-chain locks by operators not yet in the featured roster (anticipatory).

scan_ready.description: false during the first ~90s while the LockedAmulet scan runs.

get.description: CIP-0118 super-validator locking and vesting state, derived from the DSO rules and on-chain locked amounts.
The most recent validator/super-validator reward-collection events observed in the index.
Index of the API surface: endpoint list, docs/spec/llms links, the MCP endpoint, and the anonymous rate limit. Intended as an agent entry point.

BearerAuth.description: API key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Omit for anonymous (per-IP) access.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded — see the Retry-After header (seconds)

UpstreamUnavailable.description: The Scan API upstream did not respond — retry shortly

IndexBuilding.description: A supporting index is still building; the response carries `building: true` — retry in a few minutes

seq.description: Monotonic index sequence — the pagination cursor

round.description: Mining round (null/0 on some automation records)

amount.description: Headline CC amount — a send: sum of receiver amounts; a reward collection: gross rewards claimed; a self-transfer/merge: the sender's net change (sender_change_amount); mint/tap: their amount. null only for aborts, which move no value.

parties.description: Every party in the transaction, mapped to its roles

nature.description: Economic nature: send (to a distinct receiver), reward (validator/SV/app reward collection), self (self-transfer/merge), mint, tap, abort, or other.

rewards.description: Rewards the sender collected in this transfer (validator + SV + app; the duplicate validator_reward/validator_faucet coupon is de-duplicated via max), or null if none.

detail.description: Present only with `?detail=1`. The full transaction detail — transfer legs, exact per-leg fees (sender_fee, receiver_fee, holding_fees, sender_change_fee), balance_changes, and the ledger offset.

roles.description: How the requested party appears in this transaction

detail.description: Present only with `?detail=1`. The full transaction detail — transfer legs, exact per-leg fees (sender_fee, receiver_fee, holding_fees, sender_change_fee), balance_changes, and the ledger offset.

roles.description: The party's roles in this transaction (sender, receiver, …).

detail.description: Full financial body: `type`, ledger `offset`, and the matching `transfer` / `mint` / `tap` / `abort_transfer_instruction` payload with every party, amount, fee, and balance change

transfer.description: sender {party, input_amulet_amount, sender_fee, holding_fees, sender_change_amount, …}, receivers [{party, amount, receiver_fee}], balance_changes [{party, change_to_initial_amount_as_of_round_zero, change_to_holding_fees_rate}], transfer_kind, description
